input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: get_help_record now returns `self.help` directly, which is None when no help was set, although the docstring and return type promise an empty string. The old code substituted "" for those arguments.
- rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another has help=None. format_positional_arguments passes (metavar, None) to formatter.write_dl, which processes the second column as text (e.g. wrap_text or len on it) and raises TypeError/AttributeError, so --help crashes.
critique: The finding names the same mechanism: get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, giving None, and that None is passed into write_dl, which crashes with TypeError when --help is run on an undocumented argument. The function name differs slightly (format_positional_arguments vs format_arguments), but the defect is the same.
